mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the real interest rate becomes negative, which stimulates investment and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which leads to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 is negative for 2 consecutive quarters.
